baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَانٌ مَرْصُوصٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Mutual exposure is given a path, straightened into one line, joined as parts, and compacted until the plurality becomes load-bearing; divine love selects coordinated reliability rather than mere proximity.

activation_trace.role: Clinging love supplies the explicit divine valuation that selects this formation.
Mutual combat supplies reciprocal exposure, making the agents interdependent rather than isolated.
An extended traversed way gives the collective a shared direction.
Straight-row alignment converts many bodies into a common edge.
Building by joining parts turns alignment into a composite that can bear load.
Tight compacting closes gaps and makes each joined part answer for the others.

changed_reading.before: God loves fighters who stand close together in battle.
changed_reading.after: God loves a mutually exposed collective whose shared direction, exact alignment, and joined reliability make it function as one load-bearing body.

baseline_models.mechanism: A root branch of training until force is softened precedes images of composite constitution and fixed hardness: the paradoxical route to collective solidity is disciplining private force and accepting self-exposure.

activation_trace.role: Subduing or training until force softens supplies an inward discipline beneath outward combat.
Self-devoting struggle supplies willingness to enter severity rather than preserve the isolated self.
The straight row gives disciplined force a common geometry.
Built constitution makes solidity an emergent property of arrangement, not an individual trait.
Hardness and fixedness name the stable result of that prior discipline.

changed_reading.before: The rank is solid because each fighter is independently hard.
changed_reading.after: The rank becomes solid because private force is first trained into a shared constitution and each self accepts exposure to the others.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated fracture between utterance and action supplies the negative image of a gapped wall; the immediate turn from severe abhorrence to love makes the straight, compact rank an enacted correspondence in which declared commitment actually bears weight.

activation_trace.role: Spoken utterance supplies the declared layer whose detachment is challenged.
Producing an act supplies the missing embodied layer that speech must meet.
Repeated utterance makes the speech-action gap structural rather than incidental.
Repeated action marks performance as the required counterpart to declaration.
Severe abhorrence of ugliness supplies the evaluative opposite of the love in the focus ayah.
Love as clinging attachment reverses the preceding abhorrence when commitment becomes embodied.
Straight alignment materializes correspondence between claim and act.
Joined construction makes truthful performance load-bearing.

structural_cues: 61:2-3 repeat saying and not doing before 61:4 reverses severe abhorrence into divine love.
The focus simile replaces a verbal claim with an externally inspectable arrangement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated saying-without-doing, severe abhorrence, then love and a compact rank; I infer that enacted correspondence is the arrow from speech to structural integrity, while mere adjacency between rebuke and battle remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: The row describes tactical spacing after an unrelated rebuke about hypocrisy.
changed_reading.after: The row is the bodily form of truthful speech: no gap remains between profession, action, and the load each member claims to bear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Deviation from straightness is followed by the turning of hearts and failed guidance, converting the focus row from exterior geometry into a moral-cognitive alignment that can bend from within even while bodies remain adjacent.

activation_trace.role: The traversed way supplies the direction from which deviation can occur.
A straight row supplies visible rectitude whose inward analogue is tested.
Composite constitution lets an inward turn deform the whole formation.
Departure from straightness supplies both the human tilt and its intensified sequel.
Turning a thing away from its face makes the heart the pivot where alignment reverses.
Gentle direction to a path supplies the lost orientation against which deviation is measured.

structural_cues: 61:5 sequences knowingly harming a messenger, human deviation, divine counter-deviation, and turned hearts.
The focus path and straight row make that later deviation spatially legible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a straight path and row followed by deviation and turned hearts; I infer that inward orientation causally sustains outward cohesion, while the later sequence may instead be a separate punitive history rather than an anatomy of the rank.

changed_reading.before: Straightness is a visible battlefield arrangement.
changed_reading.after: Straightness is also fidelity of heart and direction; a formation can look aligned yet already be bending through tolerated harm and inward turning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The building root reappears as filiation, while disciples name themselves helpers and one lineage divides into wrapped factions; the focus building can therefore model an affiliation that constructs descent-like belonging without erasing the possibility of fracture.

activation_trace.role: Joining parts supplies the deliberate construction of a collective.
Filiation and derived belonging make the constructed whole resemble a genealogy.
Tight joining supplies the bonds that make affiliation consequential.
Children and lineage supply inherited belonging as the first social form of building.
The repeated lineage supplies a common origin that nevertheless branches under decision.
The disciple as helper supplies chosen affiliation alongside inherited descent.
A wrapped faction supplies the possibility that one lineage forms competing bounded collectives.

structural_cues: 61:6 addresses the children of Israel; 61:14 repeats that lineage after a call-and-response among disciples.
Within the repeated lineage, one faction believes and another rejects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root spanning construction and filiation, plus chosen helpers and a split lineage; I infer an affiliative genealogy built by response, while literal ancestry in the context and literal masonry in the focus remain fully live readings.

changed_reading.before: The building simile suppresses personal and genealogical relations in favor of anonymous units.
changed_reading.after: The building can be a made lineage: inherited identities are reassembled through chosen support, yet the same genealogy can split into rival formations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hostile mouths operate as apertures trying to still light, while completion defeats them; branches of rim, supporting ribs, and tight veiling recast the compact building as a casing whose legitimacy depends on carrying and protecting light rather than occluding it.

activation_trace.role: A rim or forward opening supplies an aperture within the path image.
Ribs and settled supports supply a protective frame rather than a featureless block.
Tight veiling around the eyes supplies both protective closure and the danger of blocking sight.
A stilled flame and cooled ember define the hostile failure mode.
Light and illumination supply the content that must remain transmissible.
The mouth opened in speech supplies the hostile aperture acting against transmission.
Arrival at completion supplies the outcome that hostile closure cannot prevent.

structural_cues: 61:8 opposes mouths attempting extinction to God's completion of the same light.
The focus structure is compact, but its branch inventory contains both supports and a veil around vision.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a compact frame, mouth-openings, attempted extinction, and completed light; I infer a protective transmission casing, while the live alternative is a warning that compact formations can themselves become veils if closure is mistaken for fidelity.

changed_reading.before: Compactness is an unqualified mass optimized to resist impact.
changed_reading.after: Compactness is tested by transmission: the formation is sound when it supports and protects light, and suspect when its closure veils what it claims to defend.

context_deltas.mechanism: Dispatch, gentle direction, tightly woven truth, and emergence turn the rank into public infrastructure: its joined supports carry a message along a way until truth becomes visible, so prevalence is not reducible to collision.

activation_trace.role: The extended way supplies a route for directed transmission.
Ribs and supports supply the carrying infrastructure of the collective.
Tight joining supplies continuity without gaps in what the structure carries.
Sending and setting forth supply movement from source toward recipients.
Gentle indication toward the path supplies the directional content of the sending.
Tight weaving in fabric or speech supplies a verbal analogue to the compact building.
Emergence and disclosure supply public visibility as the structure's effect.

structural_cues: 61:9 moves from a sent messenger, through guidance and true religion, to making it manifest.
The focus places a traversed way inside a joined and compact carrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sending, guidance, tightly woven truth, manifestation, and a joined focus structure; I infer that the collective can mediate public embodiment, while manifestation may instead remain solely divine and independent of the rank's mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The formation exists chiefly to overpower an opposing formation.
changed_reading.after: The formation also serves as gapless infrastructure through which guidance acquires durable, public embodiment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A transaction promising rescue is specified by full exertion in the same divine way with wealth and selves; this nests the focus combat within a wider economy of costly contribution and makes the building an organized deployment of heterogeneous resources.

activation_trace.role: Self-devoting struggle supplies the focus ayah's highest-risk mode of contribution.
The traversed way supplies the exact route repeated by the later exertion.
Joined construction supplies organization across unlike contributed parts.
Trade and pursuit of gain supply an input-output frame for costly commitment.
Rescue by separation supplies the promised outcome of the transaction.
Exerting full capacity under hardship broadens the operative effort beyond one act.
The repeated extended way explicitly joins the later exertion to the focus path.
Possessed wealth supplies material capacity as one class of structural input.
The thing itself or self supplies personal existence as the other class of input.

structural_cues: 61:10 asks about a saving transaction; 61:11 answers with belief and exertion in God's way using wealth and selves.
The exact path phrase recurs from 61:4 to 61:11 while the governing verb changes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated path language, full exertion, wealth, selves, and transactional rescue; I infer that combat is nested within total expenditure, while a live alternative reads wealth and selves only as resources for the same military campaign.

changed_reading.before: The loved act is principally the act of fighting, with formation as its tactic.
changed_reading.after: The martial act remains live but becomes one severe instance of coordinated total expenditure: capacities, wealth, and selves are joined and directed along one way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The subject-object direction of love reverses: first God loves the formed actors, later the actors love support and a near opening. The two loves separate divine valuation of disciplined formation from human desire for prompt success.

activation_trace.role: Clinging love names God's attachment to the people in formation.
Self-devoting severity makes that valuation meaningful before any outcome is secured.
Hardness and staying fixed supply endurance independent of immediate success.
The same love branch now names the believers' attachment to an outcome.
Aid that makes manifest supplies the desired external success.
Opening into victory supplies the event toward which human love reaches.
Temporal nearness intensifies the human preference for prompt realization.

structural_cues: In 61:4 God is the subject of love and the formed fighters its object.
In 61:13 the believers are the subject and an additional near support/opening is the object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the grammatical reversal and labels the desired outcome as an additional thing; I infer a distinction between approval and appetite, while the alternative is that 61:13 simply names the reward implied by 61:4 without disciplining motive.

changed_reading.before: Being loved by God is tacitly evidenced by obtaining the victory the actors want.
changed_reading.after: Divine love attaches to steadfast formation before outcome, while the actors' love for near victory remains distinct and must not become the measure of that approval.

context_deltas.mechanism: A summons elicits self-named helpers, a lineage divides into factions, and support strengthens one side against an enemy until it emerges; the focus row becomes a voluntarily answering network whose compactness is relational support, not erased individuality.

activation_trace.role: The straight row supplies a visible coordination of distinct responders.
Joining parts supplies a network made through relation rather than sameness.
Tight joining supplies dependable lateral support among responders.
Repeated aid and making manifest supply the collective identity requested and claimed in response.
The disciple as helper supplies persons whose identity is defined by answering the call.
Wrapped factions supply bounded groups produced by divergent responses.
Confirming strength supplies vertical support to the already answering network.
Enmity supplies the opposed relation against which mutual support becomes consequential.
Ascendancy supplies the eventual public result of supported cohesion.

structural_cues: 61:14 repeats a question and first-person answer about who will help, then narrates factional division and strengthening.
The focus plural is compared to one building without grammatically deleting its members.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call-and-response, helper identity, factional split, strengthening, and emergence; I infer that answering relations construct the rank, while a live alternative treats the helper episode only as a historical analogy for military solidarity.

changed_reading.before: The row is an anonymous mass whose effectiveness comes from suppressing distinct agency.
changed_reading.after: The row is built from agents who answer, name their allegiance, and support one another; unity is coordinated response across distinct persons, not their disappearance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because seed, ear-of-grain, and food-to-flesh branches cross from a martial masonry simile into botany and metabolism. It remains anchored in three consecutive focus roots and the explicit straight, compact construction; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for generative cohesion, not as a replacement translation of love, path, or building.

activation_trace.role: A carried seed-kernel supplies the smallest living unit of the collective.
An extended ear of grain supplies a natural axis that arrays many kernels.
Straight arrangement supplies the ordered disposition of those living units.
Food building flesh supplies growth from nourishment rather than assembly alone.
Tight compacting supplies the close packing that lets plurality read as one form.

changed_reading.before: The simile is exclusively an inert wall made strong by static density.
changed_reading.after: Alongside masonry, the rank can flash as a living ear: distinct kernels are aligned, nourished, and compact enough to become a generative body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The winter-slayer branch is form-distant from يُقَاتِلُونَ and cannot control its lexical translation. It remains worth carrying because the focus also contains food building flesh and fixed construction, while context contributes wealth and settled dwelling; render it only as an abductive analogy extending what coordinated struggle may preserve through provision, warmth, and shelter.

activation_trace.role: The one who slays winters by feeding and warming supplies struggle against lethal deprivation.
Food building flesh supplies bodily maintenance as constructive action.
Hardness and fixedness supply shelter-like endurance through hostile conditions.
Possessed wealth supplies the material means that can be organized for provision.
A place of settlement supplies shelter as the preserved end of the provisioning formation.

changed_reading.before: The formation defeats only a personified enemy through combat.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, its joined capacity also fights conditions that kill: it feeds bodies, holds warmth, and makes durable shelter possible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This hydraulic model is surprising because it activates marginal water and spring branches beneath an explicit battle-and-building surface. It remains anchored in the focus path, row, supports, and stones around a spring, then gains context-backed opening and rain-relief; downstream prose should label it a cross-material analogy showing that cohesion can direct passage rather than mean total impermeability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فِي سَبِيلِهِ صَفًّا كَأَنَّهُم بُنْيَانٌ مَرْصُوصٌ

activation_trace.role: Falling rain supplies moving benefit rather than a static path.
Gathering at water supplies coordinated access around a shared resource.
Ribs and settled supports supply the frame of a channel or spring-work.
Adhering stones around a spring supply compact construction that regulates flow.
Rain as relief supplies the beneficent output carried by the structure.
Water bursting from an outlet supplies controlled release through an opening.

changed_reading.before: A compact building is strongest when nothing can pass through it.
changed_reading.after: In a contained hydraulic analogy, strength lies in joined parts that prevent destructive leakage while directing relief through a shared outlet.

strongest_changes: The compact row became enacted correspondence between saying and doing, not merely tactical spacing.
Straightness became an inward orientation of hearts that can bend before the visible rank breaks.
Combat remained live but was nested inside full exertion with wealth and selves along the repeated divine way.
The reversal from God loving the actors to the actors loving near victory separated divine approval from desired outcome.
Building became both affiliative lineage and a call-and-response support network, preserving distinct agents inside unity.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's branch spread made one compact simile carry several coexisting mechanisms: load-bearing architecture, disciplined force, truthful embodiment, lineage, transmission infrastructure, living growth, provision, and regulated flow. The odd material readings remain explicitly analogical rather than being audited away.
remaining_uncertainties: The context sequences may causally explain the focus formation or may only juxtapose neighboring concerns.
The organic, winter-provision, and hydraulic activations depend on form-distant branches and should not govern lexical translation.
Compactness may protect transmission or become a veil; the packet keeps both directions materially possible.
The filiation reading may be a genuine activation of ب ن ي or only an evocative recurrence beside literal masonry and literal lineage.
